articles.title_zh: 在不断变化的领域追踪个人知识轨迹:一般相对性和引力的情况
articles.content_zh: 历史学家在野外和通过个人职业重建了20世纪一般相对论和引力(GRG)的转变,但是将这些尺度联系起来需要一种方法来比较研究人员与随时间而变化的领域. 我们进行这种比较,将研究人员的出版物和参考文献与同一、较早和较晚的两年期间的GRG实地文献相比较。 根据我们早先的两起案件研究(arXiv:2501.00391)的词汇表和嵌入密度估计,我们把分析范围扩大到美国航天局/美国航天局约180 000GRG记录(1911年至2000年)中出版最多的50位作者,并增加了两项以引用为基础的措施,即参考词汇表和引用身份。 这四项措施将作者的书面语言,引用的文献,语义邻里,引用的作者-权威配置与周边领域进行比较. 早先的案例表明,更紧密的实地-省区对接与更密集的语义区相伴。 在五十名作者中,这种情况只存在一部分。 书面和引用的词汇往往移动在一起,通常与后来的GRG文献类似,因为这个领域转向了天体物理和宇宙学研究. 语义学街区更常见的是,外地出版物集中在较早的时期,而共同引用模式并不遵循单一的时间方向,尽管引用了相同的参考清单,但两项引用措施往往将同一个研究人员置于不同的位置。 因此,个别的轨迹可以结合与后来的字段状态相连的词汇和较古老的语义结构或引用结构,这些不同的案例标志着更紧密的历史调查模式. 这种方法将可辩证的实体界限和充分涵盖文本、参考文献和含糊的作者身份的其他领域转移。

articles.title: RankGround: Efficient High-Resolution GUI Grounding via Lightweight Reranker-Guided Crop Selection
articles.content:
Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding is a fundamental perception task for multimodal agents, enabling them to interpret natural language instructions and interact with digital interfaces. Existing methods face a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and efficiency: direct full-image inference often fails to capture small or visually similar UI elements, while multi-crop strategies improve localization at the cost of multiple expensive Vision-Language Model (VLM) calls per query.
  To address this challenge, we propose RankGround, a two-stage framework that achieves accurate GUI grounding with a single VLM call per query. Central to our approach is GroundRanker, a lightweight multimodal reranker that identifies the most promising crop from a dense candidate set. Because no off-the-shelf ranking dataset is available, we construct ranking supervision data from existing grounding datasets. A strict containment criterion and boundary-aware positive augmentation improve alignment and spatial coverage in cluttered layouts. GroundRanker is then trained with a two-stage curriculum: a pointwise objective first learns coarse containment, and a listwise objective refines subtle semantic and spatial distinctions among visually similar crops.
  Experimental results show that RankGround consistently outperforms strong baselines while reducing computational cost. It achieves 1.4 times faster inference and improves localization accuracy by 5.5% on average over the second-best method across all backbones and screen scales, establishing a new state of the art in both efficiency and precision for GUI grounding.

articles.title_zh: RankGround: 通过轻量级 Ranker- Guided 作物选择实现高效的高分辨率 GUI 定位
articles.content_zh:
图形用户界面(GUI)定位是多模式代理的一项基本感知任务,使他们能够解释自然语言指令并与数字界面互动. 现有方法面临精度和效率之间的根本权衡:直接的全图像推论往往无法捕捉到小的或视觉上相似的UI元素,而多作物策略则以多次昂贵的Visual-Langage Model(VLM)每次查询调用为代价,改善本地化.
为了应对这一挑战,我们提议RankGround,一个两阶段框架,通过每个查询一个VLM呼叫,实现准确的图形用户界面定位。 我们方法的核心是地面车手(GroundRanker),这是一种轻量级的多模式调整车型,它从密集的候选作物中找出最有前途的作物。 由于没有现成的排名数据集,我们从现有的地面数据集构建排名监督数据. 严格的封闭标准和有边界意识的正增强作用可改善布局的一致和空间覆盖。 然后,GroundRanker通过两个阶段的课程培训:一个是分明的目标,首先学习粗糙的封装,另一个是按清单的目标,完善视觉相似作物之间的微妙语义和空间区别。
实验结果显示,RankGround在降低计算成本的同时,一贯超越强基线。 它实现了1.4倍的更快推论,并且在所有主干线和屏幕尺度的第二最佳方法上,平均提高了5.5%的本地化精度,为GUI定位建立了效率和精度的新水平。

articles.title: HearInContext: A Benchmark for Implicit Context in Speech Recognition
articles.content: Contextual ASR can benefit from semantic cues or from target words explicitly provided in the context. We introduce HearInContext, a Mandarin--English benchmark that pairs shared synthetic speech with assistant replies supporting different interpretations. The benchmark comprises 3,764 semantic test cases built around homophones. Implicit contexts exclude candidate words; explicit contexts name the target. No-context and unrelated-context controls measure the benefit of relevant history and sensitivity to irrelevant history. Context-capable models benefit from implicit cues but achieve higher target recall with explicit hints. Fine-tuning Qwen3-ASR-1.7B improves implicit-context target recall by 11.0 and 11.5 percentage points in Mandarin and English, respectively, while absolute CER/WER changes on AISHELL-1 and LibriSpeech remain below 0.1 percentage points. Gains extend to explicit conditions excluded from fine-tuning and to Mandarin hotword recognition on real recordings.

articles.title_zh: HearIncontext:语音识别中隐含背景的基准
articles.content_zh: 语义上的语义提示或上下文中明确提供的目标词可以使上下文ASR受益. 我们引入了HearInContext,一种普通话-英语基准,将合成演讲与辅助回答对齐,支持不同的解释. 基准包括3,764个以同声调为主的语义测试病例。 隐性上下文排除了候选词;明确上下文为目标命名. 无文字和无关文字控制可以衡量相关历史的好处和对无关历史的敏感性. 具有上下文能力的模型受益于隐含的提示,但通过明确提示实现更高的目标召回。 微调Qwen3-ASR-1.7B使普通话和英语的隐含调试指标分别提高了11.0和11.5个百分点,而AISHELL-1和LibriSpeech上的绝对CER/WER变化仍然低于0.1个百分点. 收益扩展到排除微调的明确条件,以及普通话热字识别真实录音.

articles.title: Voice of Reason: Reinforcement Learning for Spoken Math
articles.content: Speech language models enable richer spoken interactions between humans and machines than cascaded systems, allowing access to paralinguistic information and lower latency. However, their accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks has lagged behind those of text models. Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has been instrumental in extending text models' capabilities for solving complex problems and limiting hallucinations. In this work, we explore applying RL to the GLM-4-Voice speech model (Zeng et al., 2024) to bridge the gap between textual and spoken mathematical problem solving. We first adapt the model to the domain using supervised fine-tuning on synthesized spoken question-answering data. We then show that, even without extra reasoning tokens, RL improves the accuracy on GSM8K beyond levels previously achieved for speech models only with supplementary reasoning traces. When combined with existing streaming reasoning techniques, we show further gains to 74.8% free-form accuracy. This establishes a new state-of-the-art for mathematical spoken abilities with speech-native models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 理性之声:加强语法数学学习
articles.content_zh: 语音语言模型使得人类和机器之间的口语互动比级联系统更丰富,使得人们能够获取准语言信息,并降低延迟度。 然而,它们在数学推理基准方面的准确性落后于文本模型。 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RL)有助于扩展文本模型解决复杂问题和限制幻觉的能力。 在这项工作中,我们探索将RL应用于GLM-4-Voice语音模型(Zeng等人,2024年),以弥合文字和语言数学问题解决之间的差距. 我们首先通过对综合的口头问答数据进行有监督的微调,使模型适应域。 然后我们显示,即使没有额外的推理符号,RL也会提高GSM8K上的精度,超过以前仅以补充推理痕迹实现的语音模型的水平. 结合现有的流线推理技术,我们进一步显示出74.8%的自由式精度. 这为数学口语能力与语音本地化模型建立了新的先进水平.

articles.title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions
articles.content: An AI assistant that calls tools makes two decisions on every request: which tool to invoke, and whether any available tool applies. In the usual design a single language model makes both, by emitting a call or by declining to emit one. On a device that has to answer without a server, the language model is what makes that design expensive, dominating both the latency and the memory of the router. The common alternative is to remove the model completely and rank the catalog of local actions with a retriever instead. That substitution is not symmetric across the two decisions. A retriever returns its highest-scoring candidate for every input and cannot signal that the catalog holds no valid action. Our earlier study found that constraining a decoder to a tool grammar repairs malformed output without improving the choice. What the substitution costs in each decision has not been measured. We evaluate the two decisions separately over 600 Korean and English requests and a catalog of 70 local actions. The router may also ask for a missing slot, reply, or delegate. Half the in-catalog requests reuse catalog vocabulary and half paraphrase it, separating lexical overlap from the action requested. Character 3-gram BM25 selects 162 of 164 lexically matched requests and 85 of 166 paraphrases. Restricting the candidate set to seven raises the paraphrase figure to a mean of 0.825 over five trials. No classifier over its score features separates in-catalog from out-of-catalog above 0.697 area under the curve, where the frozen encoder multilingual-e5-base reaches 0.806. Using that encoder for abstention alone keeps 376 of the requests local and misroutes 9 of the 150 needing delegation. Abstention, not selection, is where a neural component is required. A neural ranker improves every quality metric and is rejected on latency and memory rather than accuracy.

articles.title_zh: 选择是检索, 留置不是: 超过 70 个韩英动作的在线搜索工具
articles.content_zh: 一个调用工具的AI助手对每个请求做出两个决定:哪个工具可以引用,以及是否有任何可用的工具适用. 在通常的设计中,一种单一语言模式通过发出呼叫或拒绝发出呼叫而使两者兼而有之。 在一个没有服务器必须回答的设备上,语言模型是使得这种设计变得昂贵,同时占据路由器的空闲性和内存. 常见的选择是完全删除模型,用一个检索器来排序本地动作的目录. 这两种决定的替代并不对称。 检索器返回每个输入的得分最高的候选人,不能表示目录没有有效动作. 我们早先的研究发现,在不改进选择的情况下,将解码器限制在工具语法修补错误的输出上. 每项决定中有哪些替代成本没有计量。 我们分别评价这两项决定,600多项韩国和英国的请求以及70项当地行动目录。 路由器也可以要求丢失的槽,回复,或代表. 一半的目录中请求复用目录词汇和一半的解译,从请求的动作中分离出词典重叠. 字符3-gm BM25在164个逻辑匹配的请求中选择162个,在166个参数中选择85个。 将候选人人数限制在7人以上,使比喻数字在5次审判中达到0.825的平均值。 其分数特征上没有分类器将内目录与曲线下超过0.697区域的外目录区分开来,其中冷冻编码器多语种-e5基数达到0.806. 仅使用这个编码器弃权就保留了376项请求的本地和150个需要的代表团中的9项。 拒绝而不是选择是需要神经元件的地方. 神经分级器能提高每个质量度量,在耐久性和记忆性上被否定而不是准确性.

articles.title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions
articles.content: Warning: This paper contains examples of stereotypes and social bias. LLMs are increasingly used in interactive settings by the general public, making the evaluation of model behavior in multi-turn conversational scenarios important for safety, including stereotyping-related harms. However, existing multi-turn social bias evaluations often rely on pre-specified or template-based user inputs that do not adapt to model responses and typically assume a fixed dialogue length in advance. In this paper, we study social bias dynamics in response-conditioned multi-turn interactions using a controlled evaluation protocol that generates follow-up user queries from the evolving dialogue history and allows evaluation over variable numbers of turns. Experimental results show that LLMs exhibit social bias even in coherent, response-conditioned multi-turn interactions, revealing late-emerging bias, non-monotonic bias patterns, and bias re-emergence. These results motivate evaluations that extend beyond fixed-turn, pre-scripted protocols. Our findings highlight the importance of analyzing social bias as a turn-level dynamic phenomenon.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DyMT-ESB:对用户-LLM中社会偏见的动态多回合评价 互动
articles.content_zh: 警告: 本文列举了定型观念和社会偏见的例子。 一般公众越来越多地在互动环境中使用LLMS,这使得在多回合对话情况下对模型行为的评价对安全至关重要,包括与陈规定型观念有关的伤害。 然而,现有的多回合社会偏见评价往往依赖于预先指定或基于模板的用户投入,这些投入不适应模型响应,通常提前假定固定对话长度. 在本文中,我们利用一个可控评价协议,研究在响应条件的多回合互动中的社会偏见动态,该协议产生来自不断变化的对话历史的后续用户查询,并允许对变化的回合数进行评价。 实验结果显示,LLMS表现出社会偏见,即使是在连贯的,有响应条件的多回合互动中也是如此,揭示了晚期出现的偏见,非情绪偏见模式,以及偏见再现. 这些结果促使评价超越了固定的、预先规定的协议。 我们的调查结果强调,必须分析社会偏见,将其作为一个转折的动态现象。

articles.title: Fallacy Benchmarks Measure Scheme Recognition, Not Fallacy Detection
articles.content: Fallacy-detection benchmarks pair fallacy classes with a single "valid" or "none" class that takes everything data collection did not label as a fallacy. This construction is misleading: a classifier can learn cues that do well on this class without learning to tell a fallacy from a correct argument. We show that the low false-positive rates benchmarks report are an artifact of how the class is built, not evidence of detection ability. The most informative negative for a fallacy is a correct argument using the same argumentation scheme, and such arguments are at most a few percent of the valid class across the four benchmarks we examined. Evaluated on constructed scheme-matched negatives, false-positive rates rise from 16.6% to 58.9% on CoCoLoFa and from 5.7% to 62.0% on Reddit. That rate depends on how the negatives are written, so we also compare two conditions from the same pipeline that differ only in scheme identity. Classifiers label scheme-matched negatives as the source fallacy type 40.9 points more often than wrong-scheme negatives, which are instead identified as the scheme they actually use 85.9% of the time against 0.4% for the source type. The classifier has learned which scheme an argument uses, not whether it uses it correctly, and on the benchmarks' own test sets the two are indistinguishable. The same dissociation appears in three zero-shot LLM detectors that never saw these benchmarks, and the measurement is far lower on a negative class that was built deliberately. We release the items as Scheme Foils. A reported false-positive rate should not be trusted as a measure of detection until the valid class has been audited for scheme-matched coverage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 错误基准 测量计划识别, 而非错觉检测
articles.content_zh: 谬误-检测基准将谬误类与单一的"有效"类或"无"类相配,将所有数据收集都取而代之,并没有被标签为谬误. 这种构造是误导的:分类者可以学习在这个班级上做得很好的提示,而不学习从正确的论据中分辨一个谬误. 我们显示,低假阳性率基准报告是该阶层是如何构建的,而不是检测能力的证据。 对于一个谬论来说,信息最丰富的负面是使用同样的论证方法的正确论证,这种论证最多是我们所审查的四个基准中有效分类的几 %. 经对已建方案对应的负数进行评估后,CoCoLoFa的假阳性率从16.6%上升到58.9%,Reddit的假阳性率从5.7%上升到62.0%。 这个速率取决于底片的写法,所以我们也比较了两个条件与同一个管道,这些条件只在方案特性上有所不同. 分类者将计划匹配的负数标注为40.9分而非错误的化学式负数的源谬误类型,而错误的化学式负数被确定为它们实际使用时间的85.9%,而源类型为0.4%. 分类者已经了解到一个论点使用的是哪个方案,而不是它是否正确使用它,在基准本身的测试中,两者是无法区分的。 同样的离散出现在三个从未见过这些基准的零射LLM探测器中,在故意建造的负类上测量要低得多. 我们把那些东西作为"Foils计划"放出来 在对有效类别进行与计划相称的覆盖面审计之前,不应相信报告的错误阳性比率是检测措施。

articles.title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) often suffer from capability stagnation in self-improvement training because fixed difficulty levels fail to adapt to their evolving proficiency. To address this issue, we propose STRETCH (Self-Taught Reasoning Evolution via Targeted CHallenge), a unified framework inspired by cognitive scaffolding theory. STRETCH introduces a dynamic Stretch Zone mechanism that continuously aligns question difficulty with the model's solving capability. Within a single parameter space, the model alternates between a Scaffolder that generates adaptive, boundary-pushing challenges and a Learner that that optimizes its solving trajectories through reinforcement learning. This dual-loop co-evolution effectively stabilizes training, mitigates reward hacking and promote progressive reasoning growth. Experiments on both negotiation and operation research benchmarks demonstrate that STRETCH consistently outperforms strong prompting and domain-specific baselines. Further scaffolder configuration analysis shows that dynamic difficulty alignment is critical for sustained capability improvement and synchronized reasoning evolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 结构 边界:进步的LLM统一自学框架 进化
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在自我改进训练中经常受到能力停滞的影响,因为固定的难度水平无法适应其不断发展的熟练程度. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用STRETCH(通过定向CHALLENGE进行自我教育理性进化),这是一个受认知脚手架理论启发的统一框架. STRETCH引入了动态伸展区机制,不断将问题难度与模型的解析能力联系起来. 在一个单一参数空间内,在产生适应性强,横跨边界挑战的脚手架和通过强化学习优化其解析轨迹的学习者之间,模型替代. 这种双轨合流有效地稳定了培训,减轻了对黑客的奖励,促进了渐进推理的增长. 关于谈判和操作研究基准的实验表明,技术研究和技术系统的业绩始终高于强有力的提示性和特定领域基线。 进一步的脚手架配置分析显示,动态难度调整对于持续的能力提高和同步推理演化至关重要.

articles.title: Weakening Neurons: An Input-Output Functionality in Transformers with Outsize Influence
articles.content: We analyze the learned input-output behavior of GLU-based neurons in large language models (LLMs). We propose a simple analysis method: For each neuron, we compute the cosine similarities between its input (reading) and output (writing) weight vectors. In this scheme, a strong negative cosine similarity indicates the neuron weakens the direction it detects in the residual stream, so we call this a weakening neuron. This allows us to gain a number of novel insights. First, we show that nine different LLMs have similar patterns: weakening neurons appear mostly in late layers whereas their counterparts, (conditional) strengthening neurons, are frequent in early-middle layers. Second, we find that weakening neurons display surprising behavior: even though there are few, they activate often and have a large influence on model behavior. Third, weakening neurons have a strong effect on model output when gate values are negative -- which is surprising since negative gate values are not expected to encode functionality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 弱化神经元:具有外延影响的变换器中的输入输出功能
articles.content_zh: 我们分析大语言模型(LLM)中基于GLU的神经元的学习输入-输出行为. 我们提出一个简单的分析方法: 对于每个神经元,我们计算其输入(读)和输出(写)重量矢量之间的余弦相似性. 在这个方案中,强烈的负余弦相似性表明神经元会削弱它在剩余流中检测到的方向,所以我们称之为弱神经元. 这使得我们能获得一些新的见解。 首先,我们显示九个不同的LLMS有相似的规律:弱神经元多出现在后层,而它们的对应物(有条件的)加强神经元则经常出现在中早期层. 其次,我们发现弱神经元表现出出乎意料的行为:尽管很少有,但它们经常激活,并对模型行为有较大影响. 第三,弱化神经元在门值为负时对模型输出有强烈的影响——这令人惊讶,因为负门值预计不会编码功能.

articles.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
articles.content: As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance. In these contexts, compliance with rules specified in an agent's system context is a first-order legal concern. Currently, no evaluation framework systematically measures which LLM models tend to violate compliance rules, especially under pressure from a persistent user, a hurried manager, or circumstances where violation is convenient or attractive. We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. We use PACT to profile LLM compliance across six complementary metrics that create a holistic picture of an AI assistant's robustness under pressure and throughout multi-turn conversations, its transparency, and ability to correctly discern where a rule applies. We aggregate this profile into PACTScore, a reliability-weighted compliance rate over all items and modes. Our results across 22 common LLM models spanning multiple providers and sizes show substantial variability in compliance across models and metric dimensions. Even the strongest assistants mis-apply a rule on 6 to 10% of items, and ordinary user pressure raises the violation rate by 65% on average. PACT highlights compliance risks in LLM assistants, motivating guardrails and careful model selection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PACT:企业AI助理能否在压力下被信任?
articles.content_zh: 随着公司AI的采用继续增长,企业级的LLM代理正在部署在雇用、保健和金融等敏感背景下。 在这些情况下,遵守一个代理人的系统环境中规定的规则是一阶法律问题。 目前,没有一个评价框架能够系统地衡量LLM模型往往违反遵守规则的情况,特别是在持续使用者、仓促管理者的压力下,或在违反规则是方便或有吸引力的情况下。 我们引入了PACT(压力-应用合规测试),这是AI代理在压力下协助员工在12个受监管的企业领域和48个情景下执行日常任务的遵循规则的基准,每个情景都是在现实的多回合对话中设定的. 每个基准项目对一个与规则比对的快捷方式的常备规则,并应用不同措辞和系统即时模式的各种压力。 我们按严格的LLM即审即决审计的构成部分构建了PACT部分,以确保样本清晰、不可置疑和现实,避免引起具有评价意识的行为。 我们使用PACT来描述六个互补的衡量标准对LLM的遵守,这些衡量标准为AI助手在压力下和整个多回合对话过程中的稳健性、透明度以及正确辨别规则适用之处的能力创造了一个整体的画面. 我们将此概况汇总为PACTScore,这是对所有项目和模式的可靠性加权遵守率。 我们跨越多个供应商和规模的22个共同LLM模型的结果表明,不同模型和计量维度的遵守程度有很大差异。 即使最强的助手也错误地对6-10%的项目适用了一条规则,普通用户的压力平均将违规率提高了65%. PACT突出了LLM助理的合规风险,激励护栏和仔细的模型选择.

articles.title: Variational Quantum Transformer Architecture for Synthetic Language Generation
articles.content: We propose a compact NISQ-compatible quantum transformer architecture for synthetic QNLP sequence modelling. The model preserves the autoregressive next-token interface of a classical transformer, but replaces attention and feed-forward sublayers with variational quantum encoder blocks, connector circuits, decoder blocks and a direct two-qubit measurement readout. Token contexts are angle-encoded into small quantum registers, processed by parallel variational heads and encoder integration circuits and conditioned through decoder ancillae to produce a distribution over a four-token vocabulary. We evaluate several architecture variants on deterministic and lexicographic grammar-generation tasks against a compact classical transformer baseline. The quantum models are trainable end-to-end and learn nontrivial grammar structure, including perfect deterministic generation in individual runs and high lexicographic validity in the strongest variant. The classical baseline remains more accurate and stable and the quantum models are sensitive to initialization. The contribution is therefore not a claim of quantum advantage, but a concrete architecture and evaluation of transformer-inspired QNLP sequence modelling under near-term quantum constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 合成语言生成的变量量子变换器架构
articles.content_zh: 我们提出一个紧凑的NISQ兼容量子变压器结构,用于合成QNLP序列建模. 该模型保留了古典变压器的自递式下键接口,但以变异量子编码器块,连接器电路,解码器块和直接的双位测量读出取代了注意和向导子层. 托肯语境被角编码成小量子登记册,通过平行的变形头和编码器集成电路处理,并通过解码安切乐来进行条件化,以生成一个分布在四个托肯语词汇上的分布. 我们对照紧凑的古典变压器基线,对确定式和词典法生成任务的几个结构变体进行评估。 量子模型是可训练的端到端并学习非三角语法结构,包括单个运行中完美的定型生成和最强变体中的高词法有效性. 古典基线仍然比较准确和稳定,量子模型对初始化很敏感. 因此,该贡献并不是声称量子优势,而是在近期量子限制下,对变压器启发的QNLP序列建模的具体架构和评价.

articles.title: A Probe Shift Is Not a Fairness Fix: The Limits of Representation Steering in Speech Models
articles.content: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems exhibit unequal error rates across speaker groups, motivating interventions on their internal representations. We ask whether speaker-linked attributes that are linearly readable from pretrained ASR encoders yield useful directions for reducing group word-error-rate (WER) gaps. Across Whisper-medium, HuBERT-large, and Wav2Vec2-large on Common Voice and the Speech Accent Archive, we probe every encoder layer for metadata-derived sex/gender, age, and native/accent labels; construct centroid and probe-derived directions; inject them at selected layers; and compare downstream probe trajectories with matched WER changes. Sex labels are highly decodable (best macro-F1 0.924--0.941), native/accent labels are also above chance (0.544--0.696), and age is weaker (0.354--0.397). Of 22 post-selected reruns, nine have 95% paired-bootstrap intervals entirely below zero, yet every absolute source-group WER reduction is below 0.7 percentage points. Conversely, a local target-class probe rate can rise from 8.09% to 99.87% while WER worsens. Linear readability is therefore neither evidence of causal use nor a reliable mitigation method. Our results motivate evaluating speech-bias interventions jointly at representation, propagation, and task levels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探险移位不是公平措施:发言模式中代表指导的限度
articles.content_zh: 自动语音识别(ASR)系统显示各发言人组的误差率不均,促使对其内部表述进行干预。 我们询问,从预先训练的ASR编码器中可线性读取的与扬声器有关的属性是否为减少组词-错误率(WER)差距提供了有益的方向。 透过Whisper-media, HuBERT大调和Wav2Vec2大调在Common Voice和Speech Accent Archive上, 我们调查每个元数据生成的性别、年龄和本地/accent标签的编码层; 构建中心机器人和探测器生成的方向; 将它们注入选定的各层; 并将下游探测器轨迹与相应的WER变化进行比较。 性标签的解码性很强(最佳宏F1 0.924-0.941),原生/cent标签也高于机会(0.544-0.696),年龄更弱(0.354-0.397). 在22次选后重播中,有9次的配对-bootstrap间隔完全低于零,然而每一次绝对源组WER的减幅都低于0.7个百分点. 相反,局部目标级探测率可以从8.09%上升到99.87%,而WER则恶化. 因此,线性可读性既不是因果使用的证据,也不是可靠的缓解方法。 我们的成果促使人们在代表性、传播和任务层面共同评估言论偏见干预。

articles.title: Machine Translation between English and Syriac (East Syriac Dialect) using Statistical Machine Learning
articles.content: UNESCO considers the Assyrian (Syriac) language an endangered language. Although Assyrians speak the language worldwide, the speaking population is uncertain (ranging from 500,000 to 1,500,000). Syriac is also one of the least studied languages in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Despite advances in Machine Translation (MT) over the past decade, the lack of publicly available corpora and the orthographic complexity of the Syriac script, specifically the Madnkhaya script, have left this language entirely ignored in the computational linguistics literature. This study develops the first phrase-based Statistical MT (SMT) model for English-to-Assyrian MT using the Moses framework. We created a dataset of 38,847 sentence pairs from the complete English and Syriac Bible, merging a pre-existing New Testament dataset with an Old Testament built from scratch through PDF extraction, using custom segmentation scripts and manual alignment review by three bilingual annotators. The Syriac side of the corpus undergoes diacritic removal and Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization to reduce orthographic sparsity before training. We trained and evaluated six models using different configurations and splitting-scheme ratios, language model order, distortion limits, and the inclusion of an Operation Sequence Model. The best-performing configuration achieves a word-level BLEU score of 23.54. Human evaluation by 11 native Assyrian speakers resulted in mean adequacy and fluency scores of 3.42 and 3.34 out of 5, respectively. These results are consistent with comparable low-resource SMT models trained on Biblical corpora for morphologically rich Semitic languages. The corpora, scripts, and trained model are publicly available, providing the research community with the first systematically curated English-Syriac dataset and a reproducible baseline for future MT and broader NLP work on this endangered language.

articles.title_zh: 英语和叙利亚语之间的机器翻译(东叙利亚语 Dialect),使用统计机器学习
articles.content_zh: 教科文组织认为亚述语(叙利亚语)是一种濒危语言。 虽然亚述人在世界范围内会说该语言,但说该语言的人口不确定(从50万到15万不等). 叙利亚语也是自然语言处理(NLP)中学习最少的语言之一. 尽管在过去的十年中机器翻译(MT)有所进步,但缺乏公开的corpora,以及叙利亚语脚本,特别是Madnkhaya语脚本的整形复杂,使得这种语言在计算语言学文献中被完全忽略. 本研究利用摩西框架为英语对阿西里语MT开发了第一个基于短语的统计MT(SMT)模型. 我们从完整的英语圣经和叙利亚语圣经中创建了38,847个句子对的数据集,将原有的新约数据集与从零开始通过PDF提取而建的旧约数据集合并,使用自定义的分块脚本和由三个双语注释员进行手动对齐审查. 血清的叙利亚一侧在训练前进行二极解析和字节-平面编码,以减少整形痉挛。 我们培训和评价了6个模型,使用了不同的配置和分解-化学比率,语言模型顺序,扭曲限制,并包括了"行动序列模型". 表现最佳的配置实现了23.54的字位BLEU分数. 11名讲亚述语的本地人进行的人类评价,结果平均充足率和流利率分别达到3.42分和3.34分。 这些结果与为形态丰富的犹太语言而培训的关于圣经蝎子的可比低资源SMT模型一致. 公司、脚本和训练有素的模型已公开提供,为研究界提供了第一套系统整理的英文-叙利亚c数据集,并为今后关于这种濒危语言的MT和更广泛的NLP工作提供了可复制的基线。

articles.title: Align, Integrate, and Fire: Efficient Token-Level Alignment for Zero-Shot SpeechLLMs
articles.content: While Large Language Models excel in natural language processing, efficiently extending their capabilities to spoken input remains a significant challenge. Existing methods for building SpeechLLMs often rely on computationally expensive full-model fine-tuning, or employ parameter-efficient projectors that suffer from inefficient token sequence lengths and costly full-model supervision. In this paper, we introduce Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire, a highly efficient framework for zero-shot speech processing. Our method dynamically compresses continuous acoustic frames into the exact discrete token length of the target text utilizing explicit Dynamic Time Warping alignments. This allows our initial training stage to establish a robust acoustic-to-semantic bridge using lightweight distance metrics, entirely bypassing the computationally expensive LLM forward pass. For subsequent fine-tuning, we propose a memory-efficient knowledge distillation objective that targets a single LLM layer, performing competitively with full-model cross-entropy training at a fraction of the computational cost. Through extensive evaluations on Automatic Speech Recognition and Speech Translation, we demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance compared to prior parameter-efficient baselines.

articles.title_zh: 对齐、集成和火:零热SpeechLLMs的高效托肯级对齐
articles.content_zh: 虽然大语言模型在自然语言处理方面表现优异,但有效地将其能力扩大到口语输入仍然是一个重大挑战。 建造SpeechLLMs的现有方法往往依赖于计算成本昂贵的全模型微调,或者使用参数高效的投影器,这些投影器受到无效的符号序列长度和昂贵的全模型监督. 在本文中,我们介绍了Acontrol Control-Control-and-Fire,这是零镜头语音处理的高效框架. 我们的方法利用明确的动态时间摇摆对齐方式,将连续的音响帧压缩成目标文本的确切离散符号长度. 这使得我们的初始训练阶段能够使用轻量级距离测量值建立坚固的声学对语义桥,完全绕过计算昂贵的LLM前传. 对于后续的微调,我们提出一个内存高效的知识蒸馏目标,目标为单一的LLM层,以计算成本的一小部分与全模跨体训练进行竞争. 通过对自动语音识别和语音翻译的广泛评价,我们表明,我们的方法比以往的参数效率基准提高了性能。

articles.title: Size Matters: Foundation Model for Czech HTML documents
articles.content: Creating universal, high-quality representations of web documents in high-traffic industrial environments requires models that are both performant and economic. Existing approaches, however, often depend on large models, overlook the structural information inherent in HTML, or are constrained by short context windows, limiting their ability to process real-world web pages. We present HTML-LM, a compact foundation model with 154 million parameters that addresses these limitations through HTML-aware training and a ModernBERT-based architecture. It was trained on 100 million web documents using multiple objectives, including masked language modeling, bag-of-words prediction, and contrastive distillation from large language models. Consequently, HTML-LM sets a new state-of-the-art for classification and regression applications in the Czech Internet domain, surpassing both larger encoders and small-sized LLMs. The model is deployed in production, processing thousands of web documents per second, and released to the community under the CC BY-NC 4.0. https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm.

articles.title_zh: 大小事项: 捷克 HTML 文件的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 在高流量工业环境中建立普遍、高质量的网络文件代表,需要既能发挥作用又能经济的模型。 然而,现有方法往往依赖于大型模型,忽略了HTML固有的结构信息,或者受到短上下文窗口的限制,限制了它们处理现实世界网页的能力. 我们提出HTML-LM,这是一个紧凑的基础模型,有1.54亿个参数,通过HTML-aware培训和基于现代BERT的架构来解决这些局限性. 它接受了关于1亿个网络文件的培训,使用了多个目标,包括蒙面语言模型,包字预测,以及大语言模型的对比衍射. 因此,HTML-LM为捷克互联网域的分类和回归应用设置了新的最新技术,超过了更大的编码器和小型LLMs. 该模式部署在制作中,每秒处理数千份网络文件,并在CC BY-NC 4.0下向社区发布. https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-22.

articles.title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens. Their fidelity is commonly evaluated using pointwise reconstruction metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), yet small individual errors do not fully characterize how faithfully action adjustments across demonstrations are preserved. After compression, similar actions may still cluster around a representative motion, while the adjustments needed for different contexts are diminished, distorted, or even reversed. We introduce physical rank consistency (PRC) to measure how well tokenization preserves local physical distance rankings after reconstruction. Evaluating decoded actions provides a common reference across token vocabularies and decoder architectures, complementing pointwise accuracy with a measure of relational fidelity. We further present ActionPiece, which preserves physical action relationships through joint supervision of representation learning and quantization. Physical rank preservation supervises near-far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization applies the same ordering to codeword assignment distributions. Both objectives augment reconstruction, producing discrete action tokens for standard autoregressive policy learning and execution through a frozen decoder. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B policy training setup, ActionPiece achieves 94.8% on LIBERO and 68.8% on unseen LIBERO-Plus, with additional evaluations reaching 71.9% on SimplerEnv and 51.5% across VLA-Arena L0-L2. Component ablations show that the two objectives jointly improve PRC and policy success, demonstrating the value of physical relationship supervision for action tokenization.

articles.title_zh: ActionPiece: 反思自动退步视野-语言-行动模式的动作触摸
articles.content_zh: 动作示意器在自旋式视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型中发挥着中心作用,既确定了政策培训的目标,也确定了从预言符中恢复的可执行指令. 通常使用如平均方位错误(MSE)等指针来评价其忠诚度,但小的个别错误并未充分说明如何保持整个演示的忠实行动调整。 压缩后,类似的动作仍可能围绕一个具有代表性的动议集群,而不同背景所需的调整则会减少,扭曲甚至逆转. 我们引入了物理阶次一致性(PRC),以衡量在重建后如何很好地保持当地物理距离排名。 评价解码动作为符号词汇和解码器架构提供了共同的参考,用一个关系忠诚度的度量来补充点精度. 我们进一步介绍ActionPiece,它通过对代表性学习和量化的联合监督来维护实际行动关系。 实体级的保存监督在编码器和定量特征距离上近距离订购,而定量规范化对编码字分配适用同样的命令. 这两个目标都加强了重建,通过冷冻的解码器为标准的自动政策学习和执行提供了独立的行动标志。 在相同的Qune3-VL-4B政策培训设置下,ActionPiece在LIBERO上达到94.8%,在看不见的LIBERO-Plus上达到68.8%,附加评价在SimmerEnv上达到71.9%,在VLA-Arena L0-L2上达到51.5%. 组成部分显示,这两个目标共同改进了项目设计与政策的成功,显示出实物关系监督对行动象征性化的价值。

articles.title: Divide and Conquer: Mixture-of-Bottleneck Experts in Informative Ordinal Space for Video-based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
articles.content: Video-based Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) must handle information from text, audio, and image sequence in human speaking videos, yet current methods often fail to integrate modalities with task awareness. Most models treat video sentiment prediction as a single task, overlooking its ordinal nature, and their fusion strategies struggle to capture diverse unique and synergic cues across modalities. To address these limitations, we adopt a divide-and-conquer perspective by reformulating MSA as an ordinal regression problem and decoupling it into polarity recognition and intensity prediction. Driven by information theory, we introduce a Mixture-of-Bottleneck (MoB) framework that assigns different latents to polarity- and intensity-specific experts for different modalities. With the learning of information bottleneck, each expert learns compact and task-relevant representations while filtering out redundancy and noise. A multimodal bottleneck routing fusion module then fuses these expert latents with hard mining strategy, guiding the prediction in the ordinal sentiment space. Extensive experiments on 4 MSA datasets and 4 language models show that MoB effectively leverages informative latents from diverse modalities and captures general sentiment structure. Beyond stronger performance, MoB comprehensively captures fine-grained intra- and inter-modal dynamics, enabling more trustworthy localization of nuanced video sentiment signals.

articles.title_zh: 分化和征服:波特伦克多式感知分析信息标准空间问题专家
articles.content_zh: 基于视频的多式联运情绪分析(MSA)必须处理人语视频中文本,音频,图像序列中的信息,然而目前的方法往往无法将模式与任务意识结合起来. 大多数模型将视频情绪预测视为一项单一的任务,俯瞰其正统性,他们的聚变策略努力捕捉不同的独特和协同方式的提示. 为了克服这些局限性,我们从分化和征服的角度出发,将管理事务协议重新定为一种正常回归问题,并将其与极性识别和强度预测脱钩。 在信息理论的驱动下,我们引入了混合-Bottleneck(MoB)框架,为不同模式的极性和强度特定专家分配不同的潜质。 随着信息瓶颈的学习,每位专家在过滤冗余和噪音的同时,也学习与任务相关的紧凑表述。 一个多模式瓶颈的路由聚变模块然后将这些专家潜伏物与硬采矿策略结合,指导在正轨感知空间的预测. 对4个管理事务协议数据集和4个语言模型的广泛实验表明,财政部有效地利用了不同模式的信息潜伏,并掌握了一般情绪结构。 除了更强的性能外,B部还全面捕捉到模式内和模式间精细的动态,使得细微的视频情绪信号能够更可信地本地化.

articles.title: Disentangling Long-Term Memory via Latent Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
articles.content: Personalized agents are required to reason over long-term history interactions to infer both explicit preferences and implicit behavioral evidence. While early flat retrieval methods score memory fragments independently and neglect the distributed information, current structured memory frameworks rely on query-agnostic static graphs that fail to capture the context-dependent relations. Crucially, raw textual memories are inherently entangled and noisy, making fine-grained personalization and cross-session reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present LGM, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term memory disentanglement into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of persisting fixed graphs, we design a tailored latent graph construction with a sparse autoencoder. Subject to each query, it maps historical interactions into latent memory nodes and disentangles the memory traces into sparse concept activations, dynamically synthesizing query-aware relational edge weights. (ii) A graph encoder then treats the query embedding as a conditioning preference to direct non-linear message passing across the task-specific latent subgraph. This yields a highly expressive memory representation for effective activations. Extensive experiments on long-term personalization benchmarks demonstrate that LGM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing both explicit and implicit preferences while enabling personalized responses.

articles.title_zh: 通过Latent Neuro-Symbolic消除长期记忆 理由说明
articles.content_zh: 要求个性化的代理商在长期历史互动中进行推理,以推断明确偏好和隐含的行为证据. 虽然早期的扁平检索方法独立地对内存碎片进行评分,忽略了分布的信息,但目前结构化的内存框架依赖于无法捕捉到上下文依赖关系的查询-不可知静态图. 关键的是,原始的文字记忆本质上是缠绕和吵闹的,使得精细的个性化和跨会场推理在计算上令人望而却步. 为此,我们提出LGM, 一个新的神经-连锁框架, 将长期记忆分解 转变为一个持续的潜在空间。 具体地说,(一)我们设计了一种量身定制的潜伏图构造,其自动编码器很少,而不是持续的固定图。 根据每个查询,它将历史的相互作用映射到潜在的内存节点,并将内存痕迹分解为稀疏的概念激活,动态合成了查询-知觉关系边缘的权重. (二)一个图表编码器然后将查询嵌入作为对直接的非线性消息的一种条件偏好,通过任务特定的潜在子图传递. 这产生了一种高度表达性的内存表现,用于有效的激活. 关于长期个性化基准的广泛实验表明,液化石油气在捕捉明示和默示偏好方面大大超过最新基线,同时促成个性化反应。

articles.title: M-SQE: Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation for Enhancing Language Equality in Agentic Skill Use
articles.content: Agent skills, reusable procedural documents that extend LLM agents beyond their parametric memory, have become an important interface for deploying agents on real-world tasks. Community-maintained skill libraries built around this interface are growing rapidly. However, this ecosystem remains deeply English-centric: our audit finds that low-resource languages such as Swahili and Hindi have no in-language skill content, so retrieval often returns a skill written in a different language than the query, degrading accuracy and recall. A practical solution is to synthesize in-language skills for retrieval but the quality can be unreliable, so relevance in this setting alone often surfaces a related but unusable candidate. To address this, we propose M-SQE, a post-retrieval Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation framework that scores candidates via a Theory view for intrinsic quality and an Action view for task-grounded utility, unified into a domain-conditioned final score. We evaluate M-SQE across three skill-use domains: general, tool-use, and cultural tasks. Empirically, we build three-layer candidate skill pools mirroring today's ecosystem, where M-SQE's task success exceeds existing baseline's average by at least +3.5 points across three different retrievers. Particularly, M-SQE lifts the lowest-resource languages most (+12.9pp on Hindi and +5.6pp on Swahili) and achieves strong performance across all six culture regions, thereby moving agentic skill use toward linguistic and cultural equality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: M-SQE: 提高代理技能语言平等的多种语言技能质量评估 使用
articles.content_zh: 代理技能,可重复使用的程序文件,将LLM代理扩展至其参数内存之外,已经成为部署代理执行现实世界任务的重要接口. 围绕这一接口建立的社区维护技能图书馆正在迅速发展。 然而,这一生态系统仍然以英语为中心:我们的审计发现,斯瓦希里语和印地语等低资源语言没有语言技能内容,因此检索往往会返回用不同语言书写的技能,从而降低准确性和召回性。 一个实际的解决办法是综合各种语言技能进行检索,但质量可能不可靠,因此,仅在这种情况下,相关性往往显示出一个相关但无法使用的候选人。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用M-SQE这一检索后多种语言技能质量估计框架,通过对内在质量的理论观点和对基于任务效用的动作观点对候选人进行评分,统一为域内条件的最终分数。 我们评估M-SQE在三个技能使用领域:一般、工具使用和文化任务。 从经验上讲,我们建造了三个层次的候选技能池,镜像今天的生态系统,其中M-SQE的任务成功率在三个不同的检索器上至少超过了现有的基线平均值+3.5分. 特别是,M-SQE提升了资源最低的语言(印地语为+12.9pp,斯瓦希里语为+5.6pp),并在所有六个文化地区都取得了强劲的成绩,从而将代理技能的使用转向语言和文化平等。

articles.title: Planning or Improvisation? Stress-Testing the Poetry Planning Site on Open Models and Open Cross-Layer Transcoders
articles.content: Lindsey et al. (2025) report that Claude 3.5 Haiku plans rhymes: features for candidate rhyme words are active on the newline before a line is written, and a suppress-and-inject intervention redirects the line only when applied there (their Figure 13). We test how far this generalizes on seven cells crossing four open models (0.6B to 2.6B parameters) with six open cross-layer transcoders (CLTs), on one consumer GPU, decomposing the claim into position specificity (C1), newline site identity (C2), and a newline-resident plan (C3). This is a stress test rather than a faithful reproduction: attribution graphs are unavailable for these CLTs, so features are found bottom-up from decoder vectors. C1 generalizes, in every cell and in all 247 of 444 prompt-by-inject pairs with a detectable effect, but the effective position is the final prompt token, adjacent to emission, and only two cells reach behaviorally meaningful probabilities. C2 and C3 are not recovered by any probe: a census of every active feature finds no rhyme-anticipating enrichment at the newline, and steering the newline while the model composes the whole line, over 36 runs and 8,640 sampled lines, shows why. That intervention is strong but one token long, making the injected word the first word of the composed line in 703 of 720 samples and leaving the rhyme six words later untouched. A final test drops the transcoder entirely: patching the newline's whole residual, at every layer, from a minimal-pair poem whose third line ends on a different rhyme moves the rhyme in 11 of 1,260 composed lines against 4 at baseline, with a design resolving 1.4%. We read this as a boundary condition rather than a refutation: at this scale and with these transcoders, the causal site is emission-adjacent. We reproduce Figure 13's shape, not its mechanism. Code and data are public (code: github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site).

articles.title_zh: 计划还是即兴? 在开放模型和开放跨激光转换器上测试诗歌规划网站
articles.content_zh: Lindsey等人(2025年)报告说,Claude 3.5 Haiku计划押韵:在一行写完之前,候选押韵词的特征在新线上活动,而压制和注入的干预只有在该线被应用时才会重定向(他们的图13). 我们测试在7个细胞上通过4个开放型号(0.6B到2.6B参数)与6个开放的跨层转码器(CLTs),在1个消费型GPU上,将要求分解为位置特异性(C1),新线站点身份(C2),以及新线-居民计划(C3)上的通用程度. 这是一种压力测试,而不是忠实的复制:这些CLT没有归属图,因此从解码器向量中发现了自下而上的特点. C1概括,在每一个细胞和全部247个444个有可探测效果的快速偶联中,但有效位置是最后的即时信号,毗邻排放,只有两个细胞达到行为有意义的概率. C2和C3没有被任何探测器回收:对每个活性特征的普查发现新线上没有韵母吸收浓缩,在模型构成全线时引导新线,超过36条运行线和8,640条采样线显示原因. 这种干预很有力,但只留下一个象征意义,使注入的词成为720个样本中的703个中构成的行的第一个词,留韵6个词后来没有被触及. 最终的测试将转码器完全放下:将新线的完整残存,每一层都从一个最小的pair诗中补上,第三行结束于不同的韵律上将韵律在1,260条编组的行中的11条移动到基线的4条,设计解决率为1.4%。 我们把它视为一个边界条件,而不是一个反驳:在这个尺度上,用这些转码器,因果地点是排放相邻的。 我们复制图13的形状,而不是它的机理. 代码和数据公开(代码:github.com/PCfVW/诗歌-规划-网站).

articles.title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Multi-turn agent trajectories often contain redundant rounds (failed tool calls, parallel sub-queries, verification-only steps) that inflate both training and inference cost. We propose viewing each trajectory as a \emph{round-level dependency DAG} that exposes which rounds are globally load-bearing for the final answer, and fine-tune agents on trajectories refined through this DAG. Given an LLM-annotated DAG, these edits are deterministic and interpretable, with optional rephrasing. Models trained on these refined trajectories consistently outperform those trained on the original trajectories at lower inference cost. Specifically, across four multi-modal QA benchmarks, our refinements improve downstream accuracy by up to $1.7$\,pp over vanilla SFT (and $5.7$\,pp over an LLM-deletion baseline) while reducing per-sample inference messages by up to approximately $40\%$ and inference tokens by up to approximately $48\%$, translating to substantial savings in compute and serving cost. Code is available.

articles.title_zh: 依赖性- 知觉轨迹
articles.content_zh: 多回合代理轨迹往往包含冗余弹(故障工具调用,平行子query,只核查步骤),既会增加训练成本,也会增加推论成本. 我们提议将每个轨迹看成一个\emph{ 圆级依赖DAG} 揭示哪些轮子是全球的负载 用于最后的答案, 鉴于LLM-附加说明的DAG,这些编辑具有决定性和可解释性,可选重写. 接受过这些精细轨迹培训的模型,以较低的推论成本,一贯优于接受过原始轨迹培训的模型。 具体地说,在四个多式联运质量评估基准中,我们的改进提高了下游的准确度,比香草SFT高达1.7美元pp(比LLM-删除基准高5.7美元pp),同时将每个样本的推论信息减少约40美元,推论信条减少约48美元,从而大大节省了计算和服务费用。 密码有

articles.title: Emotion Experience, Expression, and Perception: Emotion Analysis on Multimodal Social Media Posts
articles.content: Emotions are an essential aspect of human communication, particularly on social media, where authors frequently combine text and images to convey their emotions. Yet prior work on emotion analysis of social media posts has overlooked two important aspects in regard to measuring how well readers can reconstruct the authors' intent: (1)~the image modality, with most work focusing solely on text, and (2)~the real-world events that trigger the expressed emotions, and their relationship to the post content. We therefore study the relation between (a) the author's experience of the event that caused them to write a social media post and (b) the content of the post, with a focus on readers' capability to reconstruct that emotion expression. To do that, we introduce the Multimodal Multi-Emotion-Model dataset Mult2EMo, created by collecting annotations from both authors and readers on the posts and their triggering events. We find that reconstruction is possible but challenging for both human readers and computational models. We show that understanding the triggering event is crucial for accurate reconstruction, and that reconstruction is particularly challenging when posts rely heavily on the image to express emotion.

articles.title_zh: 情感体验、表达和观念:对多模式社交媒体的情感分析
articles.content_zh: 情感是人类沟通的一个基本方面,特别是在社交媒体上,作者经常将文字和图像结合起来来表达自己的情感. 然而之前关于社交媒体文章情感分析的工作忽视了衡量读者如何重建作者意图的两个重要方面:(1)~图像模式,大部分作品只关注文本,(2)~引发表达情绪的真实世界事件及其与文章内容的关系. 因此,我们研究(a) 作者对导致他们撰写社交媒体文章的事件的经历与(b) 文章内容之间的关系,重点是读者重建这种情感表达的能力。 为此,我们引入了多模式多模式数据集Mult2EMo,通过收集作者和读者关于文章及其触发事件的说明而创建。 我们认为重建是可能的,但对人类读者和计算模型都具有挑战性。 我们显示,了解触发事件对于准确的重建至关重要,当各哨所严重依赖图像来表达情感时,重建尤其具有挑战性。
